relevance.rationale: A 2025 Boise State MSc thesis giving a careful exposition of the Andersen-Garoufalidis-Kashaev state-integral over an archimedean local field: the construction from an ideal triangulation with balanced angle data valued in a Gaussian group, convergence of the integrand as a tempered distribution under positivity and a homological constraint, the pentagon identity for the angle-deformed quantum dilogarithm Psi_{a,c} supporting 2-3 Pachner invariance, and gauge invariance under changes of internal angle data. It contributes no new theorem -- it re-derives results the corpus's primary sources already own -- so its key-results list is empty per the skill's rule. It is nonetheless worth registering as a readable secondary account of two objects the corpus asserts: the operator pentagon Phi(P)Phi(Q) = Phi(Q)Phi(P+Q)Phi(P) in rem:q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator, and the balanced-angle-structure setting the corpus's angle-structure LP/SDP dictionary uses. Reading it surfaced a separate citation gap worth recording (see the actions).

proposedActions.rationale: A citable expository account of the angle-deformed (charged) quantum dilogarithm pentagon and the balanced-angle state integral, both asserted in the corpus.

Surfaced while reading this thesis: the corpus names 'the Andersen-Kashaev state integral' in a reference note and in the 5_2 GK-bridge audit's definition of state-integral dressing, but no Andersen-Kashaev ref() entry exists. The PRIMARY source is the one actually missing; this thesis is only its exposition.
